How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a sovereign digital commerce stack is built around three key components: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. With this architecture, digital creators can automate the delivery of digital products and accept Bitcoin without any platform fees or restrictions.
